title: Elite: The Crocodile Crown
description: Elite remix of The Crocodile Crown: the same story pressure becomes a sharper tactical problem, not a stat-inflated repeat.
lore: This mission shows the Sun Realm refusing panic: law, river, and formation answer the Gate wound without rewriting established Canon.
terrain: open desert road, raised obelisks, and timed sunflare tiles

objectives.primary: Complete two battlefield stages under changing solar hazards. Elite remix: complete it while stabilizing a secondary solar seal.
optional: Stop every reinforcement trigger or defeat the reinforcement commander first

enemyWaves.entry: split flanks with one enemy already contesting an objective

boss.mechanic: changes start positions, suppresses one recovery lane, and forces objective timing

specialRules: Sunflare Tiles: marked tiles flare after one turn.
River Push: light channels slide units one tile if they end exposed.
Elite Remix: enemy AI prioritizes objectives and exposed support Titans.
Restricted Recovery: healing or recovery tiles deactivate after use.
victoryConditions: Complete two battlefield stages under changing solar hazards.
Secondary solar seal stabilized before extraction

firstClear: Elite Aten Ra mission 8 codex shard

stars.three: Primary, secondary, and all optional objectives completed

squadDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard 5-Titan squad; special future modes may override team size explicitly.
